canonical.title: Weekend in Taichung Around a Michelin Dinner

siblings.title: Things to Do in Taichung
siblings.summary: A weekend in Taichung built around one Michelin dinner: walkable art districts by day, night markets after dark, and the few day trips that actually fit.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Taichung
siblings.summary: Taichung has one 3-star Michelin restaurant (JL Studio) and zero 2-star restaurants — all 7 of Taiwan's 2-star restaurants are in Taipei.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events in Taichung
siblings.summary: GDG Taichung runs free monthly AI workshops and an annual DevFest at Feng Chia University.
